subject: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow
messages:
From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@muxcloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow

Hi Mina / Ben / Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the potential to bundle MuxCloud's orchestrator with Redwood's inference runtime for joint customers. We want to get the marketplace listing and initial co-sell playbook started so we can target a Q4 pilot.

High-level asks from our side:
- Marketplace listing metadata template (SKU mapping, pricing band guidance)
- Required technical artifacts for the listing (manifest, integration spec)
- Proposed sales motion and referral/co-sell crediting for the first 6 months

I've attached our initial integration spec and a rough LOI that outlines joint GTM commitments (see attachments). Can you confirm who your internal owner is for the publisher submission and an expected timeline for the listing review?

Also: are you able to support co-sell enablement sessions for our sales team in mid-August?

Thanks,
Alex
Partner Lead — MuxCloud
Attachments: mux_integration_spec_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), mux_signed_loi.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@muxcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow

Alex — great to hear and thanks for sending these over.

Quick answers and owners:
- Marketplace publisher submission: Marissa will be the primary contact for the catalog listing and evidence collection.
- Technical artifacts: engineering needs the manifest.yaml + sample deployment and a smoke test checklist (we can accept the spreadsheet as a starting point).
- Sales motion / credits: Ben and Vivek — can you draft the initial co-sell crediting model (commission split / referral credits) and a 6-month pilot SLA?

Timeline proposal:
- Week of 7/19: Redwood review of manifest + integration spec, list gaps
- Week of 7/26: Marissa opens publisher intake, we assemble evidence (security, billing, integration tests)
- Week of 8/9: Internal review and partner enablement session prep
- Target listing submission: 8/23 (aim for Q4 pilot kickoff in Sept)

I'll coordinate reviews and push for a compact review cycle — our catalog team typically needs 10 business days once evidence is complete.

Mina Haddad
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@muxcloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow

Looping in planned commercial asks. Alex, thanks for the LOI — I've attached a simple pricing matrix and suggested SKUs that map to your three deployment tiers. Main points:

- Proposed commercial model for pilot (3 months): 70/30 referral split in favor of Redwood on new joint customers where Redwood handles inference billing.
- For customers who purchase MuxCloud-managed orchestration + Redwood Dedicated, we propose a bundled SKU (redwood.mux.bundle.hourly) with a 10% uplift on base inference rates.
- We need to confirm meterability for combined billing — Marissa, can the catalog accept a composite SKU manifest (listing_manifest.yaml) or do we need two separate catalog entries?

Attachments: co-sell_pricing_matrix.csv, listing_manifest.yaml
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/7892
DocuSign LOI: https://www.docusign.com/txn/abc12345

Next steps I propose:
1) Commercial alignment and sign LOI by 7/22
2) Technical integration smoke-test by 8/2
3) Internal enablement + sales deck by 8/9

Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: co-sell_pricing_matrix.csv (text/csv), listing_manifest.yaml (text/yaml)
From: Partner Ops <partners@muxcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@muxcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow

Thanks — quick update from legal/ops:
- LOI: signed and returned (attached: mux_signed_loi.pdf).
- Mux engineering has a few questions on the manifest: can the listing include an "optional_partner_integration" field so we can surface joint features in the marketplace UI?
- Billing: We will need a merchant-of-record (MOR) conversation if the bundle includes both companies' consumables. Do you have a preferred template for the MOR play?

Proposed timeline is still good but we have one constraint: our sales kickoff week is 8/9–8/13. If you can do the enablement before 8/9 we can fold Redwood into our kickoff. Are you available for a 60-minute enablement slot on 8/6 or 8/5 PST?

Regards,
Partner Ops — MuxCloud
Attachments: mux_signed_loi.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Partner Ops <partners@muxcloud.com>, Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@muxcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector integration + marketplace listing: MuxCloud connector & co-sell flow

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the signed LOI — welcome aboard. A few concrete items and owners to close before the enablement:

Action items:
- Marissa: open the publisher intake ticket and confirm whether a composite SKU is acceptable or if we need separate entries (due 7/21)
- Ben & Vivek: draft the MOR options and a short commercial memo (due 7/21) — Ben please include the pilot crediting model
- Engineering (we will loop infra): confirm smoke-test harness and optional_partner_integration field support (due 7/26)
- Mina (me): schedule enablement with your sales and ops teams for 8/6 10am PST if that works for the Mux schedule; will send calendar invite and a one-pager for the enablement.

UX note: Marissa — if the catalog accepts an "optional_partner_integration" flag we should include a short blurb and two screenshots in the Drive folder so the marketplace UI can surface joint value props.

Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate the invites and track owners in the HubSpot deal.

Mina Haddad
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
